descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-14 In-Room Dictation & Note Generation · S20 Existing spec: a note-generation call logs its total time and the vendor's time separately

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U15 Generate timing: each run logs how long the AI call itself took, separately from the total; any run over 30 s where the AI service was not the cause is reviewed with Vikram. … (UAT 3.5)
  • U16 Each run records which AI ran: the note model (Haiku, or Mistral with the fallback recorded) and the speech-to-text engine used for the dictation (GPT-Live; Deepgram only with the ambient option). (UAT 3.1; UAT 3.9; TFA-94422 AC 6)

Test design technique: Performance (performance) — Measure the time and check it is within the required seconds.

Given Tim's api spec calling ai/notes:generateNote

When Run the spec by title

Then The aiCallLog row for notes.generateNote has providerMs ≥ 0 and durationMs ≥ providerMs and ≤ the measured time; the audit row carries the same provider_ms

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright verdict (3.5: AI time logged apart from the total). The per-call times and models of the S11 to S19 runs are read from the same rows right after each call (aiCallLog keeps only the 8 newest rows per user) and listed for review; runs over 30 s are flagged, not failed

Where it ran: local lane A (existing Playwright tests); test method API · API (Convex functions); lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S20 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-14.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane A.

Test method: API · API (Convex functions); secondary: PERF · Performance timing — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: matrix (lane A).

Existing specs:

  • api/ai-call-timing.spec.ts [api] — an AI call's log row and audit row carry the total and the vendor's time — expected

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A (Tim's api spec): it calls ai/notes:generateNote directly and reads the aiCallLog and audit rows on the local stack; dev has no admin key and the dev runner calls no action, so it runs on the local stack only (Quinn 2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
